title: Gevo, Inc. 8-K Filing — Withdrawal of DOE Loan Guarantee Application
summary: Gevo, Inc. (GEVO), a Nasdaq-listed company specializing in sustainable aviation fuel and renewable hydrocarbons, withdrew its application for a Department of Energy loan guarantee for its ATJ-60 synthetic aviation fuel project in Lake Preston, South Dakota. The withdrawal was made on April 15, 2026, citing that enhanced oil recovery business objectives are not yet commercially viable at scale, and that alternative financing opportunities better aligned with company strategy. The company will continue work on its smaller ATJ-30 project in Richardton, North Dakota.
key_points: Gevo withdrew its DOE loan guarantee application for the ATJ-60 project (Lake Preston, SD) on April 15, 2026, before the conditional commitment expired.
Primary reason cited: enhanced oil recovery (EOR) business objectives are not commercially viable at scale in the project area.
Secondary reason: alternative financing and broadened product offerings are better aligned with company strategy and can accelerate project execution.
The conditional commitment from DOE's Office of Energy Dominance Financing (EDF) was originally extended until April 2026.
Gevo intends to resubmit an application for a project at a later date if desired.
The company will continue its ATJ-30 project in Richardton, North Dakota as it remains in line with overall strategy.
